effect_description_eng: [Main] Play 1 purple level 4 or lower Digimon card from your trash without paying its memory cost. Then, if you have a Digimon with [Myotismon] in its name in play, 1 of your Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ (This Digimon can block in the blocker timing.) until the end of your opponent's next turn.
